mainEntity.name: How much does a dog attack attorney cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most dog attack attorneys, including the Law Office of Brett Peterson, work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront legal fees. Instead, the attorney's fees are a percentage of the compensation you receive from a settlement or court award. If your case does not result in a financial recovery, you typically owe no attorney fees. This arrangement allows victims to pursue justice without financial barriers.
